name: TextArea
summary: Several lines of text, sent by a separate action (a comment, a summary, a note), at a fixed number of lines or growing with the text, with a character count, read-only and invalid states. Not for one line that saves on its own (use TextField), or for text that must autosave while typing.
a11y: A native `textarea` named by its visible `label` (with "(optional)" when marked); the hint, count and error are linked with `aria-describedby`, and an error sets `aria-invalid`. The count is announced politely only as the limit nears. The box shows the focus ring, so it's never clipped. Read-only stays focusable. While processing, the words under the box say what's happening and are announced politely once; the gradient ring is never the only cue.

keys.action: leaves the field; Enter adds a new line
with `onEnter`, sends; Shift+Enter adds a new line

props.name: label
props.description: A noun phrase naming what goes in, with no colon: "Comment".

props.name: onChange
props.description: Every change, as the person types. The text is sent by a separate action, such as an Add button.

props.name: hint
props.description: One short sentence: what the text is for or what happens to it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example, never the label or an instruction.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible lines before it scrolls (or, with `grow`, the lines it starts at).

props.name: grow
props.description: Grows with the text, from `rows` lines to about twelve, then scrolls; the person never has to drag it taller.

props.name: size
props.description: The text size on the Button scale: `xs` and `s` dense (body-sm), `normal` (default) and `m` the label size, `l` and up larger, for a composer that is the page's main input. Height comes from `rows`.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The most characters it takes; a count shows under the box and is announced as the limit nears.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "(optional)". Fields are required by default, so only optional ones are marked.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the text without letting it change; still focusable, selectable and scrollable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The text can't change here and needn't be read. Prefer `readOnly`, or say why in the hint.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong with the text and how to fix it, shown under the box until it's fixed. Marks the field invalid.

props.name: combobox
props.description: For a compound that suggests while typing (Mentions): makes the text area an APG combobox for its popup list.

props.name: processing
props.description: An AI prompt box while a model works on what was sent: words for what it's doing, e.g. "Writing a reply". The box's ring turns the AI gradient (held still under reduced motion), the words show under the box with a turning arc in place of the hint, and they're announced once when the work starts. The text stays editable.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label where the surroundings already say what the box is for (a chat composer); it still names the box.

props.name: onEnter
props.description: Enter sends instead of adding a line: called on Enter without Shift (and never mid-composition, for IME input); Shift+Enter adds a line. For a composer whose text is sent as a message.

props.name: tray
props.description: Inside the box, above the text: what goes with it (a composer's attachments). The box stays the one enclosure.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Inside the box, under the text: a row of quiet actions (a composer's tools and Send). Gives the box the composer's larger corners; pressing the row's empty space puts the caret in the text.
